items.desc: A fire broke out on a busy highway in Egypt’s capital, Cairo, on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people after a fuel truck reportedly overturned. The suspected driver was arrested on Thursday, according to Egypt’s public prosecutor’s office.

items.title: Meelaha ugu badan ee ay ka dhacaan tacaddiyada loo geysto haweenka Soomaaliyeed iyo QM oo baaq adag dirtay
items.desc: Soomaaliya, ayay hay'addu sheegtay in dhaqamada waxyeellada leh ee weli baahsan, oo ay ka mid tahay gudniinka fircooniga ah, ay sidoo kale saameeyaan qiyaastii 98 boqolkiiba haweenka iyo gabdhaha Soomaaliyeed, halka 45 boqolkiiba gabdhaha loo guuriyo ka hor inta aysan gaarin da'da 18 sano.
